params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page. Defaults to 50; maximum is 100.

params.name: kind
params.description: One or more entry kinds to include. Accepted values: routine_run, automation_run, thread_story, agent_quality_verdict, generic. Omit to return all kinds.

params.name: level
params.description: One or more severity levels to include. Accepted values: debug, info, warn, error, audit. Omit to return all levels.

params.name: after_cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `after_cursor` field. Returns entries newer than the cursor's position.

params.name: before_cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `before_cursor` field. Returns entries older than the cursor's position.

params.name: agent
params.description: Restrict results to entries associated with these agent IDs (`agt_...`). Accepts multiple values.

params.name: org
params.description: Restrict results to entries associated with these organization IDs (`org_...`). Accepts multiple values.

params.name: team
params.description: Restrict results to entries associated with these team IDs (`tem_...`). Accepts multiple values.

params.name: thread
params.description: Restrict results to entries associated with these thread IDs (`thr_...`). Accepts multiple values.

params.name: correlation_id
params.description: Restrict results to entries that share this correlation group identifier. Useful for tracing a chain of related events.

items.docs:
Returns a cursor-paginated list of activity feed entries visible to the
authenticated user. Entries are ordered from newest to oldest by default.
Use `before_cursor` to page backward and `after_cursor` to page forward.

Results are scoped to the caller's app. All filter params are optional and
can be combined. Passing multiple values in an array filter returns entries
matching any of the supplied values (OR semantics).

Invalid `kind` or `level` values return a 400 error listing the accepted
val
